subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose `openclaw plugins install --agent` before per-agent runtime activation, uninstall, update, inspect, and plugin trust semantics are complete?
rationale: The code can be mechanically improved, but accepting an install-only public flag is a product and security-boundary choice because it changes plugin code placement and persisted identity without delivering true per-agent runtime isolation.

options.title: Require complete scoped lifecycle before merge
options.body: Keep the public flag blocked until install, uninstall, registry discovery, update/inspect, runtime activation, docs, and tests all share one scoped contract.

options.title: Accept an explicit partial surface
options.body: Allow install-only scoped records as an experimental operator surface while documenting that activation remains global and requiring follow-up ownership.

options.title: Pause in favor of the canonical issue
options.body: Close or pause this PR and continue design on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97749 before taking code.

recommendation.title: Require complete scoped lifecycle before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the public flag blocked until install, uninstall, registry discovery, update/inspect, runtime activation, docs, and tests all share one scoped contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question is primarily product/API direction for the plugin control plane, and recent history shows broad plugin install/control-plane ownership signals.
